diagram_previews.alt: Acute triangle ABC with AB longer than AC, and the point D on AB with CD drawn. The blue circle through B, C and D has centre S below BC; E is the midpoint of BD. Grey dashed segments SC and SE carry right-angle marks at C (with CA) and at E (with AB), a red dotted segment joins A to S, and the red dashed circle with diameter AS passes through A, E, S and C.
